newsitem.title: UK: 3i rallies on hopes for smallcap growth.
newsitem.headline: 3i rallies on hopes for smallcap growth.

text.p: Shares in 3i Group, the British venture capital investment trust specialising in smaller companies, rallied to a record peak on Thursday with an increasing number of investors turning bullish on the prospects for the sector, dealers said.
By 1527 GMT, 3i shares were up 17p to 511-1/2p, after climbing as high as 513.
London-based 3i invests in small and medium sized companies that do not have ready access to capital markets.

"I don't think there's any specific story. There's just good all around demand," said one market maker. "I think it's a knock on effect from the idea that its the smaller companies that are going to take off next."
